description: Grant or revoke workspace access to an MCP integration in bulk. Reversible: only the workspaces listed change, access applies or is removed immediately for all users in those workspaces, and re-running with enabled flipped undoes a change. Source the integration id from list_mcp_integrations, workspace ids from list_workspaces, and the current access state from list_mcp_integration_workspaces. Returns a success confirmation message.

enabled.description: Whether every workspace gets access by default

id.description: The MCP integration ID or slug

override_existing_workspace_access.description: When true, global_workspace_access replaces existing per-workspace settings

workspaces.description: Array of workspace access updates; may be empty when only changing global_workspace_access

name: update_mcp_integration_workspaces
